newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF plans to auction 10-yr JGBs on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF plans to auction 10-yr JGBs on Thursday.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to offer 10-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) through a price-competitive auction on Thursday, a MOF official said on Wednesday.
The offer volume is likely to be one trillion yen, unchanged from the previous 10-year JGB auction held on November 26, bond traders said.
The coupon rate of the 10-year bonds, which will be issued later in January, is likely to be set at a record low 2.7 percent, down from the December issue's 2.8 percent, they said.
MOF will hold 10-year JGB auctions twice in January. Another auction of 10-year JGBs to be issued in late February is expected to be held later this month.
